# Development History

| Date | Milestone |
| --- | --- |
| April 2020 | Kuailu began developing enterprise cloud-office technology powered by AI. |
| April 2022 | Shenzhen Kuailu Technology Co., Ltd. was established as the Mainland China operating entity. |
| June 2023 | The beta versions of the enterprise digital application development platform and instant-messaging module were released for co-creation and private-deployment validation. |
| January 2024 | Kuailu Cloud was launched with desktop, mobile and tablet support, visual application building and AI-assisted approvals. |
| May–June 2024 | Kuailu Meeting and an integrated enterprise office platform were released. |
| September 2025 | Kuailu Cloud AI Agent 1.0 was released. |
| May 2026 | Kuailu AI Experts and Kuailu Claw were introduced for enterprise AI execution and agent development. |
